description: A metric that is not in the catalog: the agent stops after two catalog searches and answers null instead of guessing or searching other sources.

cases.name: not_in_catalog
cases.query: What is our Net Promoter Score (NPS), and which model carries it? Reply with a single JSON object only. Do not wrap it in markdown fences and do not add any other text. Required shape: {"root_id": "<metric catalog root_id or null>", "member_id": "<member_id or null>", "model": "<the dbt model that best carries this metric, or null>", "definition": "<one sentence>"}
cases.notes: No NPS root in the catalog: the agent must say so (nulls) instead of guessing.
